g.text: Native OrthoHMM ablations: four admitted QfO cells
4/7 fresh cells admitted; three scores unavailable. Initial HMM search remains on in every cell.
D-F: thick = nominal 95% paired-family interval; thin = 42-endpoint adjusted interval. All three adjusted F1 intervals include zero.
18 development-exposed SwissTrees families; retained draws reused after exact native family matches. Conditional percentile/exchangeability limits.
No intervals for other endpoints. Coverage is not accuracy. FAS sampling is unseeded; the project-defined secondary mean is not plotted.
Failed reference timing remains excluded. No isolated timing, independent confirmation, full-factorial or OrthoFinder-superiority claim.
